Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Francis Ford Coppola "co-created" the main characters of The Godfather. This is a factual error regarding the definition of "creation" in literature and film. While Coppola co-wrote the screenplay and directed the film, the characters (Vito and Michael Corleone) were originally created by Mario Puzo in his 1969 novel. The Planner's final answer ("co-created by Mario Puzo and Francis Ford Coppola") contradicts the established fact that Puzo is the sole creator of the characters, a fact consistently supported by the WebSurfer's retrieval of Britannica and Wikipedia sources which attribute the creation of the characters to Puzo. The Planner failed to distinguish between "creating a character" (authorship) and "adapting a character" (screenwriting/directing), leading to an inaccurate final solution.
